newsitem.title: USA: Andover Togs says it emerges from bankruptcy.
newsitem.headline: Andover Togs says it emerges from bankruptcy.

text.p: Andover Togs Inc, a maker of children's wear, said Tuesday that it has emerged from bankruptcy as its joint plan of reorganization filed January 30 became effective May 12.
Under the plan, Andover said it would pay all of allowed claims against the company.
To support the plan, it said it has entered into a financing agreement with the CIT Group/Commercial Services Inc for a $10.5 million credit facility.

William Cohen, Andover's chief executive officer, said that since March 19, when it filed for bankruptcy protection from its creditors, the company has consolidated its operations and substantially reduced its overhead.
